title: BT / native 256³
downsampling_method: volume mean of 4³ linear-value cells; float64 accumulation, float32 output

coordinates.orientation: Grid-axis convention, no celestial directions inferred
coordinates.sourceSampling: source sampling origin not explicitly documented

xH.label: Neutral hydrogen fraction
xH.definition: Neutral hydrogen fraction; ionized display weight is derived 1-xH, not electron fraction.

brightness_temperature.label: 21-cm brightness temperature
brightness_temperature.definition: Differential 21-cm brightness temperature including saved spin-temperature and velocity-gradient/RSD effects; signed linear values.
brightness_temperature.qualityNote: Extreme finite Tb in BT source caches; no corrections applied. Do not treat finite/readback validation as physical validation.

density.label: Density contrast
density.definition: Matter density contrast δ = ρ / mean(ρ) − 1 from PerturbedField; no log transform.

caveat: Averaged intermediate xH is a cell-volume mean, not a resolved ionization boundary. Same seed is not proof of cross-model phase matching.
